preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output must be the value of p_u from the chosen vertex u.

postconditions.expression: all(p_u == 0 for p_u in p if p_u != 0)
postconditions.description: After processing all queries, any vertex that was chosen must have its value set to 0.
